title: Life Portfolio Design
hook: The business is booming and everything else in your life is quietly falling apart.
statement: Spread your energy across your whole life, not just one area, so one hit can't take everything down.
explainer: If work is the only thing holding you up, a bad quarter feels like a bad life. Health, people, and money outside the business are your backup.
sop: List your life areas: health, relationships, money, creativity, career, growth.
Score Diversification and Balance from 1 to 10.
Circle the area you've been ignoring most. That's your risk.
Give it one weekly action you treat like a client meeting.
Check the whole spread again every quarter.
equation_example: Diversification 6, Balance 7. 6 × 7 = 42. Higher means one rough patch won't sink everything. Lower means your whole life is riding on one area holding up.
question: Write down the life area you've been ignoring that'll catch up with you in three years.
closing_statement: Don't make one part of your life carry everything.
